claim_boundary: This gate completes readiness listing and proxy gates only; it does not complete official memory conformance.
clean_room_scope: Phase 9 memory conformance-readiness gate for clean-room Celviz GPGPU IP proxy evidence; not official OpenCL conformance, Khronos CTS pass, proprietary Vivante compatibility, production driver readiness, cache/LSU microarchitecture signoff, timing/PPA signoff, or silicon signoff

next_actions: extend from proxy traces to RTL LSU/cache traces before conformance claim
surfaces.productization_gate: H2D/D2H/DMA fill plus kernel load/store visibility must pass through unified access events
surfaces.unified_access_model: DMA-visible mutable global memory with kernel load/store and negative bounds/alignment coverage

next_actions: bind local allocation limits to compiler/runtime metadata
surfaces.productization_gate: local store/load roundtrip must pass and remain separated from host DMA-visible memory
surfaces.unified_access_model: per-workgroup local memory represented as scratchpad access events

next_actions: add compiler ABI rows for constant argument placement
surfaces.productization_gate: constant reads must be repeatable, cacheable in proxy, and reject stores
surfaces.unified_access_model: read-only constant memory with kernel load events and cache-proxy evidence

blockers: no dedicated private-memory/spill evidence in current memory model
next_actions: add private memory fixture with per-lane isolation and spill/load/store negative tests
surfaces.productization_gate: private address-space accesses, spills, lifetime, and isolation need explicit clean-room traces
surfaces.unified_access_model: per-work-item private memory/spills must be modeled as non-shared access records

blockers: current image_filter evidence is buffer/kernel proxy, not full image object conformance
next_actions: add image object fixture for formats, bounds, coordinates, and row pitch
surfaces.productization_gate: image reads/writes need explicit image-object semantics beyond buffer-backed image_filter proxy
surfaces.unified_access_model: image object access must use typed coordinates, format, bounds, and sampler linkage records

blockers: no sampler-state evidence in current memory model
next_actions: add sampler fixture covering clamp/repeat/filter mode declarations and unsupported-mode rejection
surfaces.productization_gate: sampler addressing/filter/normalized-coordinate modes require explicit positive and negative tests
surfaces.unified_access_model: sampler state must be attached to image access records for addressing/filtering modes

blockers: no atomic memory operation evidence in current memory model
next_actions: add global/local atomic fixtures, race-group ordering, and unsupported-width negative cases
surfaces.productization_gate: atomic add/cmpxchg/min/max and conflict serialization need deterministic proxy traces
surfaces.unified_access_model: atomic read-modify-write events must record ordering scope, old value, new value, and conflict group

next_actions: link coalescing groups to RTL memory issue events before performance claims
surfaces.productization_gate: coalesced transaction count must be lower than naive lane transaction count for aligned groups
surfaces.unified_access_model: lane accesses are grouped by address-space segment into coalesced proxy transactions

next_actions: separate L1/L2/TLB RTL cache evidence before cache microarchitecture claims
surfaces.productization_gate: cache proxy must record line size, hit/miss state, and claim boundary
surfaces.unified_access_model: functional line-presence cache proxy records hits/misses without microarchitecture claims

next_actions: add multi-workgroup isolation and capacity sweep evidence
surfaces.productization_gate: scratchpad lane roundtrip and group isolation assumptions must be explicit
surfaces.unified_access_model: scratchpad is the concrete local-memory backing model for per-workgroup access

next_actions: attach DMA descriptors to driver submission and RTL AXI monitor evidence
surfaces.productization_gate: H2D, D2H, copy/fill, bounds, and alignment behavior must be represented in ordered events
surfaces.unified_access_model: DMA copy/fill uses the same event schema as kernel memory access records

unified_access_model.address_space_contract: each access names address_space, operation, offset/address, size, status, and claim boundary
unified_access_model.event_contract: one ordered access record shape for DMA, kernel, cache/coalescing proxy, and negative cases
unified_access_model.negative_contract: bounds/alignment/read-only/unsupported surfaces must be explicit gate rows
unified_access_model.productization_rule: ready_proxy rows may support clean-room readiness only; gap rows block conformance claims
